station_name: San Jose Creek near Goleta, Calif.
notes: Table "Annual minimum daily discharge, water years 1966-70". The first (1966) and the last (1970) minimum are dated only "Several days", so the water years 1966 and 1970 are given instead of printed dates; the only printed dates are Sept. 3, 1967 and Oct. 2, 1968. Location paragraph also gives: on right bank at Patterson Avenue Bridge, 1.1 miles downstream from unnamed tributary and 1.7 miles northeast of Goleta.
